title: Dxcufgb's Reminders
description: Keeps legendary, villain and mythic actions, lair actions, legendary resistances, recharges and the traits GMs forget (when hit, at 0 HP, at the start or end of a turn, auras, bloodied, damage taken, saving throws, spells cast nearby) in the GM's chat at the right moments, each with its own setting. Cards list each option with its cost and the points remaining; expand Use an Action for native dnd5e Use buttons that spend legendary points through the system pipeline. When a creature with a death-triggered feature (Undead Fortitude, Death Burst...) drops to 0 HP, the GM gets a card with a sound and a Use button (this replaces Dxcufgb's Death Trigger Alerts). Each world keeps its own editable Reminder list.
